title: Measured part metadata (idea)
what_it_does: registry/__measured__.json stores per part: sourceHash, width, height, fps, durationInFrames, settle timing and copy limits (pxPerChar, maxChars), checked by a test.
when_to_use: For our part.json: record measured duration, canvas and max text length so an agent budgets the timeline without guessing.
why: Strongest idea in the registry; we write our own measure step. Also useful: a hash of the part source so a stale card is detected.
